//: CDF: P3-3-8d. A turret gun whose MAGAZINE_WELL accepts BOTH a real magazine (glockmag) and, by id, the test pocket gun. can_reload_with() builds its list from the well item_restriction, so an unrestricted well accepts nothing and the autoloader never starts; listing the gun id is what lets a gun in the cargo hold reach the is_mag test, so only the is_gun() guard in try_autoload_turret keeps it out. No shipped gun has such a well. Well volume and length are large so the item-size checks pass for any cargo item.
description: Test gun: unrestricted 9mm magazine well, no integral magazine.
